snippet.title: Rayman Legends Retold - "Macarena" Musical Level
snippet.description:
Dive into the tunes of the Glade of Dreams. Warm up your dance moves in "Macarena", a pasta-powered twist on a familiar dancefloor classic!

Glide, jump and smash your way into Rayman Legends Retold's musical levels. Available October 1.
 
Pre-order now: raymanlegendsretold.com

About Rayman Legends Retold:
Embark on a bold reimagining of the critically acclaimed platformer, enhanced with stunning 3D visuals and an immersive new story leading to a mysterious new realm. Play the adventure solo or in up to four‑player couch co‑op, jam through all‑new musical stages, saddle up for epic dragon rides, and more!
